description: Revise a quote that is still open: line items, currency, discount, VAT default, validity or notes. Totals are recomputed. An accepted or declined quote is never edited.

currency.description: Only to state the line's currency; every line on one quote must agree

description.description: every line needs a description, 500 characters or fewer

quantity.description: Hours or units, must be greater than zero

tax_rate.description: VAT percent for this line, overrides the business default

unit_price_minor.description: Price per unit in MINOR units: 9000 = 90.00 EUR, 90 = JPY 90. Never a decimal

tax_rate.description: VAT percent for lines with no rate of their own

valid_until.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Wins over validity_days, and is how an expired quote is extended

validity_days.description: Recomputes valid_until from the quote date

name: quote_update
title: Change an open quote
